name: pgnet_version
sql: select extname, extversion from pg_extension where extname in ('pg_net','pg_cron','supabase_vault')

name: key_shape
sql: select length((select btrim(regexp_replace(decrypted_secret, '^apikey=', '', 'i'), E' \t\r\n"''') from vault.decrypted_secrets where name='ten287_odds_api_io_key')) as clean_len, (select btrim(regexp_replace(decrypted_secret, '^apikey=', '', 'i'), E' \t\r\n"''') from vault.decrypted_secrets where name='ten287_odds_api_io_key') ~ '^[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$' as hex64

name: fire_noauth_identity
sql: select net.http_get(url := 'https://api.odds-api.io/v3/sports', headers := '{"Accept-Encoding":"identity"}'::jsonb, timeout_milliseconds := 20000) as id

name: fire_keyed_updated
sql: select net.http_get(url := 'https://api.odds-api.io/v3/odds/updated', params := jsonb_build_object('apiKey', (select btrim(regexp_replace(decrypted_secret, '^apikey=', '', 'i'), E' \t\r\n"''') from vault.decrypted_secrets where name='ten287_odds_api_io_key'), 'since', (extract(epoch from now())::bigint - 60)::text, 'bookmaker', 'Betfair Exchange', 'sport', 'tennis', 'markets', 'ML'), timeout_milliseconds := 20000) as id

name: responses
sql: select id, status_code, timed_out, error_msg, content_type, headers->>'Content-Encoding' as enc, headers->>'content-encoding' as enc2, headers->>'x-ratelimit-remaining' as rl, length(content) as len, left(content, 160) as head, (content is not null and left(ltrim(content),1) in ('[','{')) as looks_json from net._http_response where created > now() - interval '2 minutes' order by id

name: parse_keyed
sql: select id, jsonb_typeof(content::jsonb) as t, case when jsonb_typeof(content::jsonb)='array' then jsonb_array_length(content::jsonb) end as n from net._http_response where created > now() - interval '2 minutes' and content like '[%' order by id
